description: Navettes Aeroport Paris-Beauvais / Aerobus is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Aeroport Paris-Beauvais  // BELLOVA S.A.S. Aéroport Paris-Beauvais offers a regular shuttle service connecting the City of Paris and the Ile-de-France (Porte Maillot) to the Airport. The official Aerobus Shuttles at Paris Beauvais Airport can be booked in just a few clicks. They are accessible to all, with or without a plane ticket. Coverage: Aeroport Paris-Beauvais  // BELLOVA S.A.S. The portal shows the English title as "Shuttles Aeroport Paris-Beauvais / Aérobus" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Aeroport Paris-Beauvais  // BELLOVA S.A.S. Its keywords include netex, beauvais, aeroport-paris-beauvais, paris-beauvais, aeroport, transfert. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-05-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
